name: Checkout
description: Guest checkout flow and order capture.

options.either: Email or phone — either will do

settings.label: An order must have
settings.help: What every order from the storefront must carry. "Phone" lets somebody order with a number alone — no email, no letters, the shop rings them. No code is asked for either unless "Confirm the contact by a code" includes checkout. For a signed-in customer the form starts with what the account knows, and an account with no email is not asked for one.

keywords.en: checkout required email phone guest contact
keywords.ru: оформление обязательный email телефон гость контакт почта

options.sign_in: Ask them to sign in — a code to that email, right in the form
options.allow: Let them order as a guest

settings.label: A guest types the email of an existing account
settings.help: Signing in: the form says the address already has an account and sends a code to it; the order is placed only once they are in, so it lands in their history. A guest order to somebody else's address is how orders end up in the wrong inbox. As a guest: the order is placed, not attached to the account.

settings.label: Postal code at checkout
settings.help: Not asked — for a shop whose deliveries never need one. A delivery zone that matches by postal code then has nothing to match on, so keep it asked if you use such zones.

settings.label: Orders for a company
settings.help: A "Private person / Company" switch in the recipient step. A company gives its name (required) and its tax code; both are kept on the order, printed on the invoice and sent to 1C as the counterparty's official name and tax number.

settings.label: Minimum order amount
settings.help: In the shop's currency; 0 — no minimum. Counted on the goods in the basket at their prices, before a coupon and without delivery. Below it the basket says how much is missing and the checkout is not offered; an order a manager places is not held to it.

keywords.en: minimum order amount sum threshold smallest order
keywords.ru: минимальная сумма заказа минимальный заказ порог

options.after_buy_box: Under the buy panel, as a card of its own

settings.label: The minimum on the product page
settings.help: A note with the minimum amount and, once something is in the basket, how much is still missing. Shown only while a minimum is set.

options.hide_cheaper: It applies; no button on a product cheaper than the minimum
options.hide: It applies; no button on any product page while a minimum is set
options.exempt: It does not apply; one click takes an order of any amount

settings.label: The minimum and buying in one click
settings.help: A product's button would otherwise take a phone number for an order the shop then refuses. Buying the whole cart in one click is offered once the basket reaches the minimum, unless the minimum does not apply. Not applying suits a shop whose manager decides on the phone.

settings.label: On the product page
settings.help: A "Buy in one click" button on the product page: a phone number places a real order, and the manager rings back to agree the rest. Tick the delivery method and the payment method it uses on their own forms — the button stays hidden until both are chosen, because an order has to be placed with methods that really exist.

settings.label: For the whole basket, on the cart page
settings.help: The same button on the cart page, for everything in the basket: a phone number places the order and empties the basket. It uses the delivery and payment methods ticked for buying in one click, and is not shown while a line fails the statuses below.

options.signed_in: Only customers who are signed in

settings.label: Who is offered buying in one click
settings.help: Only guests — for a shop that wants its registered customers to use the full checkout, with their saved addresses and details. Applies to the product page and the cart alike.

settings.label: Offer it only for these availability statuses
settings.help: Nothing ticked — every product that can be bought. A product that cannot be bought never shows the button: the order would be refused after the customer typed their number.

settings.label: Cancel unpaid orders after, hours
settings.help: An order sent to an online payment and left in "Awaiting payment" is moved to the status below once it has waited this long with no money arriving. It holds no stock, so nothing is released — this only keeps the orders list clear of bank pages nobody finished. 0 turns it off. Offline methods (cash, transfer) are never touched. Checked hourly.

settings.label: … into this status
settings.help: Where an abandoned unpaid order lands. All three release stock and sit outside the working statuses. Delete the chosen one and nothing is cancelled until you pick another.

settings.label: Order number prefix
settings.help: Letters before the number: TG-000123. May be empty. Only orders placed from now on; a number already given stays on its letters and invoices.

keywords.en: order number format prefix letters numbering
keywords.ru: номер заказа формат префикс буквы нумерация

settings.label: Digits in the order number
settings.help: The number is padded with zeros to this many digits: 6 — 000123. 0 — as it is: 123.

settings.label: Next order number
settings.help: The number the next order gets; the ones after count on from it. For a shop moving in, to carry on from the old shop's count — or to start from 15 000 rather than 1. Only above the last number issued. 0 — the count goes on as it is.

keywords.en: start order number from counter sequence first order
keywords.ru: стартовый номер заказа начать с счётчик первый заказ

options.wrap: All on view, on as many rows as it takes

settings.label: Status tabs over the orders list
settings.help: A shop with many statuses may want every one in sight, to see at a glance what the managers are doing; one row keeps the head compact and scrolls sideways.

settings.label: What an order writes down about the buyer's browser
settings.help: Recorded once, when the order is placed, and shown on the order card — the address is what makes several orders from one place visible. Unticking stops recording from now on; orders placed before keep what they have. The language the order was placed in is always kept: the letters are written in it.
